corrections: Translated the stump repair confirmation and result, anomalous Green Rain forecast, raccoon shop status and the complete first five raccoon request and family-growth exchanges directly from English.
Applied locked Твърда дървесина and Зелен дъжд terminology, established Енот for the new family, and transliterated the spoken nickname bobo consistently as бобо.
Read the raccoon sequence in order and deliberately preserved its clipped, non-native grammar, ellipses, food progression and family implications while keeping the good-friend address gender-neutral.
